title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測~Bridge-foundation scour monitoring
focus: 以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋~Scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak
summary: 從長期河床降低、束縮沖刷與橋墩局部沖刷三個分量出發，以 HEC-18 公式估算沖刷深度並評估擴展基礎與樁基的暴露後果，再處理拋石保護、聲納與磁性滑環等固定式監測儀的安裝、施工期河道束縮、即時警戒值、振動頻率識別、行動計畫與洪後檢查，並以 1987 年紐約 Schoharie 溪橋、2000 年高屏大橋與 2008 年后豐大橋的斷橋為鑑。~Starting from the three components of long-term degradation, contraction scour and local pier scour, estimate scour depth with the HEC-18 equation and assess the consequences of exposure for spread footings and piles, then cover riprap protection, installation of fixed monitors such as sonar and magnetic sliding collars, construction-stage channel contraction, real-time alarm levels, vibration-based detection, plans of action and post-flood inspection, learning from the bridge failures of Schoharie Creek in New York (1987), Kaoping (2000) and Houfeng (2008).

units.anchor: 總沖刷深度三分量~Three components of total scour
units.title: 沖刷分量與洪水荷載路徑~Scour components and the flood load path
units.mechanism: 洪水對橋梁的威脅多半不是水流把橋推倒，而是把基礎下方的土砂帶走：長期河床降低來自上游攔砂、河道整治或採砂造成的輸砂失衡；束縮沖刷發生在橋孔縮窄、流速升高的斷面；局部沖刷則是水流撞到墩柱時，向下的潛流與墩前馬蹄形渦流把墩旁床料掏空。三者疊加後，若沖刷面低於擴展基礎底或使樁失去足夠的側向支撐，橋墩就會沉陷、傾斜或倒塌。台灣河川坡陡、颱風洪峰短而急，三個分量都可能在一次洪水中同時發展。~A flood rarely threatens a bridge by pushing it over; it removes the soil beneath the foundations. Long-term degradation comes from sediment imbalance caused by upstream dams, channel works or mining; contraction scour occurs where the waterway narrows and velocity rises; local scour occurs as flow strikes a pier, where downflow and the horseshoe vortex at the nose excavate the bed beside it. When the three add up so that the scoured bed falls below a spread footing or piles lose enough lateral support, the pier settles, tilts or collapses. Taiwan's steep rivers and short, intense typhoon floods can develop all three components in a single event.
units.model: 總沖刷 = 長期降低 + 束縮沖刷 + 局部沖刷 = 1.0 + 0.8 + 4.8 = 6.6 m。若基礎底面在原河床下 5.0 m，沖刷面將低於基礎底約 1.6 m，擴展基礎已被淘空；若改為樁基，樁需在 6.6 m 以下仍保有足夠嵌入。數值為教學假設。~Total scour = long-term degradation + contraction scour + local scour = 1.0 + 0.8 + 4.8 = 6.6 m. If the footing base is 5.0 m below the original bed, the scoured bed is about 1.6 m below it and a spread footing is undermined; with piles, adequate embedment must remain below 6.6 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以歷年河床斷面測量與航照比較長期降低趨勢，以水理模型取得設計洪水的水深與流速，分別計算三個沖刷分量並與基礎竣工高程比較；竣工圖不全的舊橋，要以鑽探或非破壞檢測確認基礎型式與深度。~Compare historical cross-section surveys and aerial photos for long-term degradation, obtain design-flood depth and velocity from a hydraulic model, compute the three components separately and compare with as-built foundation elevations; for older bridges with incomplete records, confirm foundation type and depth by boring or non-destructive testing.
units.failure: 2008 年 9 月 14 日辛樂克颱風期間，台中大甲溪上的后豐大橋斷落，調查認為河床落差與埋管造成約 4 至 5 m 的落差引發水躍，持續沖刷橋墩使基樁裸露；只計算局部沖刷而忽略河床落差與長期降低，會嚴重低估基礎暴露。~During Typhoon Sinlaku on 14 September 2008, the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in Taichung collapsed; investigators considered that a bed drop of about 4 to 5 m associated with a buried water pipe created a hydraulic jump that kept scouring the pier and exposed the piles. Computing only local scour while ignoring bed drops and long-term degradation badly underestimates foundation exposure.
units.misconception: 洪水沖垮橋梁主要是因為水流的推力太大。~Floods destroy bridges mainly because the water's thrust is too large.
units.practice: 沖刷評估報告要把三個分量分別列出並附上依據，標示每座橋墩的基礎底高程、臨界沖刷高程與目前河床高程；上下游的河床落差、攔河構造物與採砂紀錄須一併納入。~The scour evaluation report lists the three components separately with their basis and marks, for each pier, foundation base elevation, critical scour elevation and current bed elevation; upstream and downstream bed drops, weirs and mining records are included.

units.anchor: 橋墩局部沖刷 y_s~Local pier scour y_s
units.title: HEC-18 橋墩局部沖刷估算~HEC-18 local pier scour estimate
units.mechanism: 局部沖刷深度主要取決於墩寬、上游水深與流速（以福祿數表示）、墩頭形狀、墩軸與水流的夾角以及床況。美國聯邦公路總署 HEC-18（第 5 版，2012 年）採用的 CSU 公式以這些參數的冪次關係表示沖刷深度與墩寬之比，屬於保守的包絡估計。其中最容易被低估的是夾角：長形墩斜交水流時，有效擋水寬度大增，沖刷深度可增加五成以上；颱風洪水夾帶的漂流木堆積在墩前，也等於加寬了墩體。~Local scour depth depends mainly on pier width, approach depth and velocity (expressed as Froude number), nose shape, the angle between pier and flow and bed condition. The CSU equation adopted in the U.S. Federal Highway Administration's HEC-18 (5th edition, 2012) expresses scour depth over pier width as a power function of these parameters and is a conservative envelope. The most easily underestimated factor is skew: an elongated pier at an angle to the flow presents a much wider obstruction, raising scour depth by 50% or more; debris rafts lodged against a pier in a typhoon flood also effectively widen it.
units.model: CSU 局部沖刷公式 y_s/a = 2.0·K₁K₂K₃·(y₁/a)^0.35·Fr^0.43。墩寬 a = 2.0 m、y₁ = 5.0 m、V = 4.0 m/s，Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571；圓頭 K₁ = 1.0、正交 K₂ = 1.0、K₃ = 1.1，y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m。若長寬比 4 的墩斜交 15°，K₂ = (cos15° + 4·sin15°)^0.65 ≈ 1.57，y_s ≈ 7.5 m。數值為教學假設。~y_s/a = 2.0·K₁K₂K₃·(y₁/a)^0.35·Fr^0.43. With a = 2.0 m, y₁ = 5.0 m and V = 4.0 m/s, Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571; for a round nose K₁ = 1.0, aligned K₂ = 1.0 and K₃ = 1.1, y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m. For a pier with length-to-width ratio 4 skewed 15°, K₂ = (cos15° + 4·sin15°)^0.65 ≈ 1.57 and y_s ≈ 7.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以水理模型或實測流速分布確認墩前的 y₁ 與 V，檢查洪水主流方向與墩軸夾角在不同流量下是否改變；計算結果與相似河川的實測沖刷紀錄或水工模型試驗比較，並考慮漂流木堆積的有效墩寬。~Confirm y₁ and V upstream of each pier from a hydraulic model or measured velocity profiles, and check whether the angle between main flow and pier axis changes with discharge; compare results with measured scour on similar rivers or hydraulic model tests, and consider the effective width of debris accumulation.
units.failure: 以平時低流量的水流方向設計墩軸，洪水時主流擺動使墩斜交水流，實際沖刷遠超計算；墩群間距太近時，相鄰墩的沖刷坑互相重疊加深，單墩公式無法反映。~Aligning piers with low-flow direction lets the flood thalweg swing so piers are skewed to the flow and real scour far exceeds the calculation; closely spaced pier groups have overlapping, deeper scour holes that single-pier equations do not capture.
units.misconception: 橋墩越細長，沖刷就一定越小。~The slimmer and longer the pier, the smaller the scour always is.
units.practice: 河中墩優先採用圓形或圓頭斷面以降低對流向的敏感度，墩軸對齊洪水主流而非低水流向；設計報告列出不同夾角下的沖刷深度敏感度，並說明漂流木的處理假設。~Prefer circular or round-nosed piers in the river to reduce sensitivity to flow direction, align them with flood flow rather than low flow, and list scour sensitivity to skew angle and the debris assumptions in the design report.

units.anchor: 基礎暴露與樁側支撐~Foundation exposure and pile support
units.title: 基礎型式與沖刷後的結構後果~Foundation type and structural consequences of scour
units.mechanism: 沖刷對不同基礎的後果不同：擴展基礎一旦底下的土被掏空，承載面積驟減，基礎會傾斜或突然下陷，幾乎沒有預警；沉箱與樁基則在沖刷後失去上段土壤的側向支撐，自由長度變長，水平勁度、彎矩容量與挫屈能力都下降，且承受的流水壓力與漂流物撞擊力增加。1987 年紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋就是三號墩擴展基礎被淘空掉入沖刷坑而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡；調查也指出拋石過輕且保護、檢查與維護不足。~Scour affects foundation types differently. Once soil beneath a spread footing is removed, the bearing area shrinks abruptly and the footing tilts or drops suddenly with almost no warning; caissons and piles lose lateral support from the upper soil, so their free length increases and lateral stiffness, moment capacity and buckling resistance fall while flow pressure and debris impact grow. The 1987 Schoharie Creek Bridge collapse on the New York State Thruway began when pier 3, on an undermined spread footing, dropped into a scour hole, killing 10 people; investigators also found the riprap too light and protection, inspection and maintenance inadequate.
units.model: 懸臂樁水平勁度 k = 3EI/L³。直徑 1.5 m、E = 30 GPa，EI ≈ 7.46×10⁹ N·m²；固定點深度由 4 m 增為 10 m 時，k 由 3.49×10⁸ 降為 2.24×10⁷ N/m，只剩 (4/10)³ = 6.4%，自然頻率約降為 √0.064 ≈ 25%。數值為教學假設。~Cantilever pile lateral stiffness k = 3EI/L³. For a 1.5 m pile with E = 30 GPa, EI ≈ 7.46×10⁹ N·m²; as the fixity depth grows from 4 m to 10 m, k falls from 3.49×10⁸ to 2.24×10⁷ N/m, only (4/10)³ = 6.4%, and natural frequency drops to about √0.064 ≈ 25%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以結構模型模擬不同沖刷深度下的基礎承載、樁彎矩、側向位移與穩定，找出臨界沖刷高程（例如承載安全係數降到規定值或樁彎矩達容量的高程），作為監測警戒值的依據；擴展基礎則以基礎底高程與保護層深度直接判定。~Model foundation capacity, pile moment, lateral displacement and stability at a range of scour depths to find the critical scour elevation, for example where the bearing factor of safety reaches the required minimum or pile moment reaches capacity, and use it as the basis for monitoring alarm levels; for spread footings judge directly from footing base elevation and protection depth.
units.failure: 擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。~An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Overexposed piles bend to failure or tilt as a group under flow and debris impact.
units.misconception: 只要是樁基礎，沖刷再深也不會有問題。~If a pier stands on piles, scour depth does not matter.
units.practice: 沖刷危急橋梁的評估要同時算出擴展基礎的臨界沖刷高程與樁基在暴露狀態下的承載與穩定，並把結果寫成可供現場使用的「臨界河床高程」表；未知基礎的舊橋暫以保守假設列為高風險。~Assessments of scour-critical bridges compute the critical scour elevation for spread footings and the capacity and stability of exposed piles, writing the results as a critical bed-elevation table usable in the field; old bridges with unknown foundations are treated conservatively as high risk.

units.anchor: 拋石 D50 與護坦範圍~Riprap D50 and apron extent
units.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定~Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation
units.mechanism: 沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。拋石大小取決於局部流速的平方，墩前流速受加速影響必須放大；保護範圍要涵蓋墩寬的數倍，否則沖刷坑會從護坦邊緣向內侵蝕。固床工若在下游形成落差，又可能在其下方引發新的沖刷，后豐大橋的水躍即是例證。~Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. Riprap size depends on the square of local velocity, which must be amplified for acceleration around the pier; the apron must extend several pier widths, or the scour hole eats inward from its edge. A bed-protection structure that creates a drop can trigger new scour below it, as the hydraulic jump at the Houfeng Bridge showed.
units.model: HEC-23 墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g)。圓頭墩 K = 1.5、V = 4.0 m/s、S_s = 2.65：D50 = 0.692×36/(1.65×19.62) ≈ 0.77 m，單顆約 π/6×0.77³×2,650 ≈ 630 kg；若流速升為 5.0 m/s，D50 增為約 1.20 m。數值為教學假設。~HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g). For a round-nosed pier K = 1.5, V = 4.0 m/s and S_s = 2.65: D50 = 0.692×36/(1.65×19.62) ≈ 0.77 m, about π/6×0.77³×2,650 ≈ 630 kg per stone; at 5.0 m/s D50 rises to about 1.20 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。~During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps; after completion survey the apron top as a baseline and resurvey after floods to measure settlement or loss.
units.failure: 拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。保護工在洪後未補充，下一場洪水時基礎已無保護。~Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge; the Schoharie Creek investigation found the riprap too light. Protection not replenished after a flood leaves the foundation unprotected in the next one.
units.misconception: 在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。~Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently.
units.practice: 保護工設計要附上石塊尺寸、級配、厚度、濾層、平面範圍與預期壽命，並把洪後補充列入維護計畫；採用固床工時，同步評估下游落差可能引起的沖刷，並與水利主管機關協調。~Countermeasure design states stone size, gradation, thickness, filter, plan extent and expected life, with post-flood replenishment in the maintenance plan; when using bed-protection structures, assess scour from any downstream drop and coordinate with the water-resources authority.

units.anchor: 固定式監測儀與警戒高程~Fixed monitors and alarm elevations
units.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝~Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors
units.mechanism: 固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。美國 NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）在多州實地測試這些儀器，磁性滑環以 0.3 m 磁鐵間距可達約 ±0.15 m 精度。選擇儀器要考慮河床材料、漂流物、流速、維護可及性與資料傳輸。~Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested such instruments in several states, with the magnetic sliding collar reaching about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing. Selection must consider bed material, debris, velocity, maintenance access and data transmission.
units.model: 原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m；警戒值取 50% 為 EL +7.75 m、封橋值取 75% 為 EL +6.6 m。滑環精度 ±0.15 m，封橋值再保守提高 0.15 m 至 EL +6.75 m。數值為教學假設。~Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour; the alert level at 50% is EL +7.75 m and the closure level at 75% is EL +6.6 m. With ±0.15 m collar accuracy, the closure level is raised conservatively by 0.15 m to EL +6.75 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點；資料傳輸要做端對端測試（感測器、記錄器、通訊、伺服器、告警簡訊），並在枯水期安排定期功能檢查。~After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero; test data transmission end to end (sensor, logger, communications, server and alarm messages) and schedule periodic function checks in the dry season.
units.failure: 感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。~Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most.
units.misconception: 裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。~Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
units.practice: 監測位置以沖刷計算最深、基礎最淺的墩與墩頭為優先，至少兩種原理不同的儀器互相備援；纜線走在墩身凹槽或保護管內，設計時就預留維修通道與枯水期更換程序。~Prioritise piers and pier noses with the deepest computed scour and shallowest foundations, using at least two instruments of different principle as backup; route cables in pier recesses or protective conduits, and provide maintenance access and a dry-season replacement procedure from design.

units.anchor: 施工圍堰束縮沖刷~Cofferdam contraction scour
units.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程~Construction-stage contraction and temporary works
units.mechanism: 新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。施工計畫因此要以汛期洪水檢核臨時工程，必要時在汛期前撤除或降低圍堰。河道上的採砂也會使床面長期下降；高屏大橋所在河段在 1995 年就已撤除採砂船，顯示採砂對橋基的長期影響早受關注。~During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The construction plan must therefore check temporary works against flood-season discharges, removing or lowering cofferdams before the season where needed. Mining in the channel also lowers the bed over time; on the reach of the Kaoping Bridge, sand-dredging boats had already been removed in 1995, showing how long mining's effect on foundations has been a concern.
units.model: Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。施工圍堰使通水寬度由 300 m 縮為 240 m，k₁ = 0.69：y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166，y₁ = 5.0 m 時 y₂ ≈ 5.83 m，束縮沖刷約 0.83 m；若圍堰汛期前撤除，此量回到接近 0。數值為教學假設。~Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁. A cofferdam narrowing the waterway from 300 m to 240 m with k₁ = 0.69 gives y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166, so with y₁ = 5.0 m, y₂ ≈ 5.83 m and contraction scour is about 0.83 m; removing the cofferdam before the flood season returns it to near zero. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。~Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations; survey cross-sections regularly during construction and make removal or lowering of temporary works before the flood season an inspection point.
units.failure: 施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。~Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers; debris from washed-out temporary works piles against downstream piers, widening their effective width and deepening scour.
units.misconception: 臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。~Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered.
units.practice: 施工計畫要有汛期應變章節：明訂停止水中作業與撤除臨時工程的水位或預報條件、撤除所需時間與責任人，並由工程主辦機關與水利主管機關核准。~The construction plan includes a flood-season chapter defining the water-level or forecast triggers for stopping in-river work and removing temporary works, the time required and the responsible person, approved by the project owner and the water-resources authority.

units.anchor: 聲納測深與聲速~Sonar depth and sound speed
units.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷~Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions
units.mechanism: 聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。NCHRP 第 396 號報告的實地測試就記錄到高含氣水流時訊號遺失、佛羅里達潮汐橋墩第二年出現藤壺附著影響讀值。因此即時資料必須經過濾波與合理性檢查，並以多儀器、多指標共同判斷，而不是單一讀值觸發封橋。~Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The principle is simple, but floods bring many practical problems: heavy air entrainment or high sediment concentration absorbs and scatters sound and causes signal loss, passing debris produces false shallow readings, and transducers submerged for long periods foul with marine growth. Field tests in NCHRP Report 396 recorded signal loss in highly air-entrained flow and barnacle growth affecting a Florida tidal pier unit in its second year. Real-time data must therefore be filtered and sanity-checked, and decisions made from several instruments and indicators rather than a single reading triggering closure.
units.model: 距離 d = c·t/2。水中聲速 c = 1,480 m/s、往返時間 t = 10.8 ms，d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m；水溫與含砂使聲速偏差 2% 時，誤差約 ±0.16 m。換能器高程 EL +14.5 m，河床 EL ≈ 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m，已低於封橋值。數值為教學假設。~Distance d = c·t/2. With sound speed c = 1,480 m/s and round-trip time t = 10.8 ms, d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m; a 2% speed error from temperature and sediment gives about ±0.16 m. With the transducer at EL +14.5 m, the bed is at about EL 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m, below the closure level. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警；警戒判斷結合水位、流量、上游雨量與第二種感測器，演練時檢查告警是否在規定時間內送達值班人員。~Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time; combine water level, discharge, upstream rainfall and a second sensor in alarm decisions, and check in drills that alarms reach duty staff within the required time.
units.failure: 未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。~Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast.
units.misconception: 監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。~If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
units.practice: 行動計畫中把「設備失效」本身列為警戒條件：洪水期間若監測中斷，改以水位或流量門檻與人員目視執行預防性封橋；所有告警與處置須留下時間戳記錄。~The plan of action treats instrument failure itself as an alert condition: if monitoring drops out during a flood, fall back to water-level or discharge thresholds and visual watch for precautionary closure; every alarm and response is time-stamped in the log.

units.anchor: 墩體自然頻率~Pier natural frequency
units.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷~Detecting scour from vibration and tilt
units.mechanism: 直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。加速度計與傾斜計裝在水面以上，不受洪水直接破壞，維護也較容易。但頻率同時受溫度、水位附加質量與上部結構影響，必須先建立正常狀態的基準與變化範圍，才能從中辨識沖刷造成的偏移。~Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. Accelerometers and tilt meters sit above water, out of direct reach of the flood, and are easier to maintain. Frequency, however, also varies with temperature, added water mass and the superstructure, so a baseline and normal range must be established before a scour-induced shift can be recognised.
units.model: f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。洪前墩體側向頻率 2.4 Hz、洪峰期間降為 1.9 Hz，k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63，勁度損失約 37%；對照有限元素模型中頻率對沖刷深度的曲線，可反推等效沖刷深度。數值為教學假設。~f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)². A pre-flood lateral pier frequency of 2.4 Hz falling to 1.9 Hz at the flood peak gives k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63, about a 37% stiffness loss; comparing with the finite-element curve of frequency versus scour depth back-calculates an equivalent scour depth. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻；有限元素模型以多個沖刷深度計算頻率曲線並以洪後實測沖刷校正；傾斜計設定絕對與變化率雙重門檻，並與測量結果比對。~Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds; compute a frequency-versus-scour curve with the finite-element model at several depths and calibrate it with measured post-flood scour; give tilt meters both absolute and rate thresholds and cross-check them against surveys.
units.failure: 未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報；反之若門檻設得太寬，擴展基礎在淘空瞬間傾斜時頻率變化不大，振動法可能錯過突發破壞。~Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms; conversely, thresholds set too wide can miss sudden failure, because a spread footing that tips at the moment of undermining may show little frequency change.
units.misconception: 橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。~A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured.
units.practice: 振動與傾斜監測當作直接測深的備援與交叉驗證，而非唯一依據；監測報告要列出基準期、回歸模型、門檻與每次警報的事後檢討，持續修正判斷規則。~Use vibration and tilt monitoring as a backup and cross-check to direct depth measurement, not the sole basis; monitoring reports list the baseline period, regression model, thresholds and a review of every alarm, refining the decision rules continuously.

units.anchor: 行動計畫與封橋門檻~Plan of action and closure triggers
units.title: 沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫~Plans of action for scour-critical bridges
units.mechanism: 監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。HEC-23 第 3 版（2009 年）也強調，監測本身不能讓橋梁脫離沖刷危急的分類，只能爭取時間或在特定情況下作為對策。台灣的公路主管機關也採用分級預警封橋，例如 2026 年 6 月公告台 9 線萬里溪橋將隨上游堰塞湖警戒層級提升辦理預警性封閉。~Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. U.S. federal regulations require every bridge coded scour-critical to have one, covering inspection and monitoring type and frequency, closure and reopening criteria, detour routes, responsible staff and contacts, and the schedule for designing and building permanent countermeasures. HEC-23 (3rd edition, 2009) stresses that monitoring alone does not remove a bridge from the scour-critical category; it buys time or serves as a countermeasure in specific cases. Taiwan's highway authority also uses tiered pre-emptive closure, for example announcing in June 2026 that the Route 9 Wanli Creek Bridge would be closed as the alert level of an upstream barrier lake rises.
units.model: 水位—流量率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5。若封橋流量取沖刷達可用深度 75% 時的 Q = 8,000 m³/s，(h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7，h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93，封橋水位 h ≈ 9.9 m；水位上升速率每小時 0.5 m 時，自 8.0 m 起約 3.8 h 後達到門檻。數值為教學假設。~Stage–discharge rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5. If the closure discharge, at which scour reaches 75% of the available depth, is Q = 8,000 m³/s, then (h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7, h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93 and the closure stage is h ≈ 9.9 m; rising at 0.5 m per hour from 8.0 m, the trigger is reached in about 3.8 h. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每年汛期前檢討行動計畫：更新聯絡人、確認繞道路線可用、測試告警系統，並以桌上演練或實地演練檢查從觸發到完成封橋所需時間是否短於水位達門檻的預估時間；每次封橋事件後檢討門檻是否合理。~Review the plan before each flood season: update contacts, confirm detours are usable, test the alarm system, and check by tabletop or field drills that the time from trigger to completed closure is shorter than the forecast time for the stage to reach the threshold; review thresholds after every closure.
units.failure: 2000 年 8 月 27 日碧利斯颱風後，高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被洪水沖毀，17 輛車墜落、22 人受傷；沒有可執行的封橋門檻與即時資訊時，車輛仍在洪峰期間通行，基礎破壞直接變成人員傷亡。~After Typhoon Bilis, on 27 August 2000, floodwater washed out piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge, dropping 17 vehicles and injuring 22 people; without enforceable closure thresholds and real-time information, traffic keeps crossing at the flood peak and foundation failure turns directly into casualties.
units.misconception: 只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。~As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.
units.practice: 行動計畫要寫明誰有權下令封橋、依據哪些量化門檻、封橋與通知的步驟、警察與道路管理單位的分工，以及重新開放前必須完成的檢查；權責人須在汛期前簽認並張貼於值班處。~The plan states who has authority to order closure, on which quantitative triggers, the steps for closure and notification, the division of work between police and road agencies and the inspections required before reopening; the responsible officer signs it before the flood season and it is posted at the duty desk.

units.anchor: 洪後測深與回淤~Post-flood sounding and refill
units.title: 洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接~Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover
units.mechanism: 洪峰時沖刷坑最深，退水期間上游來砂又會回填沖刷坑，因此洪後測深看到的河床可能比洪峰時高出許多，回填的鬆散砂土也沒有原土的承載與側向支撐能力。只依洪後測量判斷，會低估基礎曾經暴露的程度。洪後檢查要結合監測紀錄的最低河床、潛水或水下聲納掃描、基礎外觀與墩體傾斜量測，並把結果寫入每座橋的沖刷歷史，作為下一次行動計畫與保護工設計的依據。~Scour holes are deepest at the flood peak, and on the falling limb incoming sediment refills them, so a post-flood sounding can show the bed much higher than at the peak, and the loose refill lacks the bearing and lateral support of the original soil. Judging only from post-flood surveys underestimates how far the foundation was exposed. Post-flood inspection must combine the minimum bed elevation from monitoring records, diver or underwater sonar scans, foundation condition and pier tilt measurements, and enter the results into each bridge's scour history as the basis for the next plan of action and countermeasure design.
units.model: 洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m；若只看洪後資料，會把最大沖刷低估 2.1 m，相當於第 5 步可用沖刷深度 4.5 m 的約 47%。數值為教學假設。~During the peak, sonar recorded a minimum bed of EL +6.8 m, while the post-flood sounding shows EL +8.9 m, 2.1 m of refill; relying on post-flood data alone underestimates maximum scour by 2.1 m, about 47% of the 4.5 m available scour depth set at the monitor-installation step. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較；異常時限制通行，由結構與水利工程師共同評估。~After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines; if abnormal, restrict traffic pending joint assessment by structural and hydraulic engineers.
units.failure: 管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。~An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand; a smaller next flood washes the loose sand out and exposes or destabilises the foundation with no preparation.
units.misconception: 洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。~The bed elevation measured after a flood is the deepest scour reached during it.
units.practice: 每座沖刷危急橋梁建立沖刷歷史檔案：基礎竣工資料、臨界沖刷高程、歷次洪水的監測最低值、洪後檢查、保護工施作與補充紀錄、行動計畫版本；資料交接時一併移交儀器設定與資料格式。~Keep a scour history file for each scour-critical bridge: foundation as-built data, critical scour elevation, monitored minimum for each flood, post-flood inspections, countermeasure construction and replenishment records and plan-of-action versions; handover also transfers instrument settings and data formats.

example: 設計練習：某跨河橋圓頭墩寬 a = 2.0 m，設計洪水上游水深 y₁ = 5.0 m、流速 V = 4.0 m/s。Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571，局部沖刷 y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×(5.0/2.0)^0.35×0.571^0.43 ≈ 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m；施工期圍堰使寬度 300 m 縮為 240 m，束縮沖刷 5.0×(1.25^0.69 − 1) ≈ 0.83 m；長期降低取 1.0 m，總沖刷約 6.6 m。擴展基礎底面在河床下 5.0 m，將被淘空約 1.6 m，必須改用樁基或加設保護工。墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692×(1.5×4.0)²/(1.65×2×9.81) ≈ 0.77 m。監測方面，原河床 EL +10.0 m、臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，警戒值 EL +7.75 m、封橋值 EL +6.75 m（含 ±0.15 m 儀器精度）；以率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5 反推，封橋流量 8,000 m³/s 對應水位約 9.9 m。若墩軸與洪水斜交 15°（長寬比 4），局部沖刷增為約 7.5 m，總沖刷超過 9 m，警戒與封橋值都須重訂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: a river bridge has a round-nosed pier of width a = 2.0 m, with design-flood approach depth y₁ = 5.0 m and velocity V = 4.0 m/s. Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571, so local scour y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×(5.0/2.0)^0.35×0.571^0.43 ≈ 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m; construction cofferdams narrowing 300 m to 240 m add contraction scour of 5.0×(1.25^0.69 − 1) ≈ 0.83 m; with 1.0 m of long-term degradation the total is about 6.6 m. A spread footing 5.0 m below the bed would be undermined by about 1.6 m, so piles or countermeasures are required. Pier riprap D50 = 0.692×(1.5×4.0)²/(1.65×2×9.81) ≈ 0.77 m. For monitoring, with the original bed at EL +10.0 m and a critical scour elevation of EL +5.5 m, the alert level is EL +7.75 m and the closure level EL +6.75 m including ±0.15 m instrument accuracy; from the rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5, a closure discharge of 8,000 m³/s corresponds to a stage of about 9.9 m. If the pier is skewed 15° to the flood (length-to-width ratio 4), local scour rises to about 7.5 m, total scour exceeds 9 m and both alarm levels must be reset. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 1987 年 4 月 5 日紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋因三號墩擴展基礎被淘空而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡，促使美國全面檢討橋梁沖刷的設計、檢查與維護；聯邦公路總署陸續發布 HEC-18 沖刷評估與 HEC-23 保護工指引，NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）則在多州實地測試聲納、磁性滑環與浮出式等監測儀器。台灣方面，2000 年碧利斯颱風後高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被沖毀，2008 年辛樂克颱風造成大甲溪后豐大橋斷落，使沖刷監測、預警封橋與河川採砂管理成為公路養護的重點。現行 HEC-18 為 2012 年第 5 版，HEC-23 為 2009 年第 3 版。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或監測文件。~On 5 April 1987 the Schoharie Creek Bridge on the New York State Thruway collapsed when the spread footing of pier 3 was undermined, killing 10 people and prompting a nationwide review of scour design, inspection and maintenance in the United States; the Federal Highway Administration went on to publish HEC-18 for scour evaluation and HEC-23 for countermeasures, and NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested sonar, magnetic sliding collar and float-out monitors in several states. In Taiwan, piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge were washed out after Typhoon Bilis in 2000, and Typhoon Sinlaku brought down the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in 2008, making scour monitoring, pre-emptive closure and control of river mining priorities for highway maintenance. The current HEC-18 is the 5th edition of 2012 and HEC-23 the 3rd edition of 2009. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or monitoring documents.
facts: Schoharie 溪橋 1954 年通車，1987 年 4 月 5 日因三號墩基礎沖刷崩塌，10 人罹難~The Schoharie Creek Bridge opened in 1954 and collapsed on 5 April 1987 when pier 3 was undermined by scour, killing 10 people
高屏大橋舊橋 1978 年完工，2000 年 8 月 27 日 P22、P23 橋墩被沖毀，17 輛車墜落、22 人受傷~The old Kaoping Bridge, completed in 1978, lost piers P22 and P23 on 27 August 2000; 17 vehicles fell and 22 people were injured
